title: Booking flow captures or confirms a contact phone number
description: A simple first-visit booking flow must ask the caller to provide a phone number when no caller number is exposed, or explicitly ask whether to use the exposed caller number as the contact number.

assertions.description: The assistant must not try to book before it has a confirmed phone number.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to create the booking before collecting a real callback number

rubric.description: The assistant should either ask for a phone number or explicitly ask whether to use the exposed caller number as the contact number.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant neither requested a spoken phone number nor made the exposed-number confirmation contact-number-specific

rubric.description: After name-only input, the assistant should not replace the missing/contact-number question with the generic phone readback phrase.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant read a caller number but asked only whether it was correct instead of asking whether it should be used as the contact number
